title: Feature activation orchestration: dashboards, rollout gating, cost breakdowns — release notes & training path
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Orchestrate the go-to-market for the upcoming Console UX feature bundle (dashboard refresh, rollout gating controls, and cost breakdowns). Deliver coordinated release notes, staged rollouts, enablement for CS/SEs, and in-product messaging. Ensure engineering, design, docs, support, and GTM are aligned and that rollback and fallback playbooks exist.
success_criteria: 1) All release notes published and translated; 2) Training completed for CS/SE with >80% pass on knowledge check; 3) Rollout executed to 20% canary then 100% with no critical regressions; 4) Post-launch cost telemetry matches projections within ±10%; 5) No high-severity incidents attributed to the change.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes copy approved by Legal & Security
Help center articles published and linked from console
Training module live with quiz + tracking
Canary rollout runbook validated and tested
Rollback playbook tested by SRE and run once in staging
rollout_plan: Week 0: Freeze UI changes and finalize help text
Week 1: Internal alpha for PM/Design/Eng; collect feedback
Week 2: Beta to 5% of accounts with telemetry gating
Week 3: Expand canary to 20% and run observability checks
Week 4: Open to all customers with staged opt-in banners
communications: Customer announcement to be coordinated by Growth; send draft by 2026-03-15
Changelog entry for hosted API: include sample payloads and migration notes
In-product banner copy: concise, link to learn-more and rollback opt-out
Internal Slack channel: #pm-console-launch (pin checklist and runbook)
training_plan: Create 25-minute on-demand module for CS/SEs with 10-question quiz
Live walkthrough session for top 20 enterprise customers (schedule with CSMs)
Playbook for Tier-1 support with triage flows and escalation contacts
Enablement office hours two times during rollout week
Tracking: attendance + quiz completion to be exported to enablement dashboard
launch_checklist: Final PRs merged and green CI
Canary targets set in routing policy
